name: UNCLI
description: AI CLIs if you're not a CLI guy.
//: The root scripts are the one command surface for every stack: VS Code tasks, CI and Claude all call npm run dev | build | check | test.
test:integration drives the real Claude CLI (it downloads the pinned version and uses your sign-in); it is not part of npm test.

scripts.check: cd app && go vet ./... && npm --prefix frontend run check
scripts.test: cd app && go test ./... && npm --prefix frontend run test:run
